data.content:
Tests To Be Done Before Going Live

  • The control of order cancelling
  • The control of order which is brought by the restaurant
  • The control of order which is brought by Getir
  • The control of discounts and campaigns both for the restaurant and Getir paid ones
  • The control of scheduled orders
  • /status/open, /status/close etc endpoint integrations

If you have completed the tests above, you must send a confirmation e-mail with the order receipt printout of an order containing the Campaign and Order Note that you have created with the data you received through the integration for your go-live processes.
